release_notes: v1.0.4 build 8503: Fondasi Profile Money Context dan locale/currency, pemisahan Base Currency dari Display Currency, perlindungan data lama IDR/LEGACY_IDR tanpa mengubah nominal tersimpan, penguatan backup/restore SQLite end-to-end, serta stabilitas refresh FX dan crypto tanpa mengubah transaksi, saldo, acquisition value, atau cost basis. Frontend production tetap Indonesia-first.
